title: Instruction Template Specification - JSON Types v1.0
description: Type library for generating raw JSON output such as values, objects, arrays and JSON Schema documents

json_value.template: <<Replace this placeholder with a single JSON value using this user prompt: ([{<{description}>}]). Format requirements: Produce one JSON value of type {valueType} (any means use whichever JSON type best fits the prompt). Output raw, valid JSON only - no markdown code fences, no surrounding commentary, and no explanation.>>
json_value.description: Generates a single JSON value of a configurable type

json_object.template: <<Replace this placeholder with a JSON object using this user prompt: ([{<{description}>}]). Format requirements: Produce a complete JSON object using {indent} indentation (compact=a single line with no unnecessary whitespace, two_spaces=pretty-printed with two-space indentation). Output raw, valid JSON only - no markdown code fences, no surrounding commentary, and no explanation.>>
json_object.description: Generates a complete JSON object with configurable indentation

config.description: A product record with id, name, price and inStock fields

examples.output: <<Replace this placeholder with a JSON object using this user prompt: ([{<A product record with id, name, price and inStock fields>}]). Format requirements: Produce a complete JSON object using two_spaces indentation (compact=a single line with no unnecessary whitespace, two_spaces=pretty-printed with two-space indentation). Output raw, valid JSON only - no markdown code fences, no surrounding commentary, and no explanation.>>

json_array.template: <<Replace this placeholder with a JSON array using this user prompt: ([{<{description}>}]). Format requirements: Produce a JSON array using {indent} indentation (compact=a single line with no unnecessary whitespace, two_spaces=pretty-printed with two-space indentation). Output raw, valid JSON only - no markdown code fences, no surrounding commentary, and no explanation.>>
json_array.description: Generates a JSON array with configurable indentation and an optional item count

itemCount.description: If specified, the exact number of items to generate

json_schema.template: <<Replace this placeholder with a JSON Schema document using this user prompt: ([{<{description}>}]). Format requirements: Produce a JSON Schema document that targets the {draft} draft, using {indent} indentation (compact=a single line with no unnecessary whitespace, two_spaces=pretty-printed with two-space indentation). Output raw, valid JSON only - no markdown code fences, no surrounding commentary, and no explanation.>>
json_schema.description: Generates a JSON Schema document describing a structure, targeting a configurable draft
